system: N=64 F=7 CP=16 S=80 pilots/slot=16 data/slot=320 nbits=1

variants.slim2: CP folding, learned front/back mixes and RE gains, differential depth 2
variants.discard_cp: Zero CP rows in both analysis transforms; retain inverse CP synthesis and full-slot RMS; reproject teacher using the changed analysis operator
variants.fixed_front: Replace front frequency mixing by fixed identity and its bias by zero; fine-tune every remaining component
variants.fixed_back: Replace back correction mixing by fixed identity and its bias by zero; fine-tune every remaining component
variants.fixed_basic_gain: Fix data-RE gain to one and bias to zero; fine-tune every remaining component
variants.serial2: Keep two tanh blocks and readout, use serial h_j=tanh(W_j h_(j-1)+b_j) instead of differential chaining
variants.full6: Differential depth 6, with every other component unchanged

training.teacher: same training-seed dense corrected-PDP checkpoints for every arm
training.initialization: least-squares projection onto each arm's own analysis operator; prescribed identity/zero values for removed corrections
training.checkpoint_selection: final fixed-budget checkpoint; no early stopping
training.paired_data: one transmit/fading/noise draw per update, physically identical received tensor consumed by all arms

evaluation.shared_stimulus: one batch generation per condition, all arms use identical inputs
evaluation.threshold: first crossing of nonincreasing BER envelope, log10(BER)-linear interpolation; explicit censoring; half-count interpolation floor only if crossing bracket has zero errors
evaluation.uncertainty: independent training-seed sample SD; bit counts not treated as independent replicates

boundary: A reproject-and-fine-tune architectural intervention, not from-scratch training. Equal update/example budgets, not equal parameter counts or wall time. 1000x256 budget differs from mainline up-to-3000x512 plus BER checkpoint selection. No JTAG, latency or resource conclusions.
